name: Air Gallet: Exa Label
storyline: In 1996, civil war has broken out in Japan. Choose from 2 different aircraft in The Silver Knights squadron comprised of the Japan Self Defense Force and US Air Force take off to find out who is behind the coup d’état. Depending upon which character you select, experience the narrative from different perspectives or team up with a 2nd player to discover more lore. Every character interaction and story sequence is now fully voiced by renowned 90’s anime voice actors giving every action on screen even more of an impact.
summary: Developed by former TOAPLAN and CAVE staff after BATSUGUN, AIRGALLET EXA LABEL is the 5th entry in the highly acclaimed EXA LABEL lineup. exA-Arcadia has teamed up again with original design chief, Junya Inoue aka Joker Jun, who returns as the Character Designer, Key Visual Illustrator and overall Scenario Director while Keishi Yonao composed the new arranged soundtrack and supervised the newly added character voices to deliver upon the original vision for this shooting tour de force.
